verdict.rationale: Cua ships an official `cua` CLI. The docs name concrete subcommands (`cua runtime doctor`, `cua runtime setup`), say Cua Driver works through MCP or a CLI, and say agent work can be followed from the CLI. A community user also reports days of hands-on use of the Lume CLI. Missing for 10: a full CLI command reference and documented AI-native ergonomics such as machine-readable output or scripting/automation guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: lets an agent drive native apps on macOS, Windows and Linux in the background, through MCP or a CLI
`cua runtime doctor` shows what this host has and `cua runtime setup` installs what is missing
follow their work from your own agent, the CLI or code
Remove Cua Spaces, the cua CLI and everything they set up with one command.
